pen_fence_chicken_1.name: Mend the Hen Fence
pen_fence_chicken_1.desc: The old fence has gaps and the hens wander off. Mend it and they lay all their eggs at home.

pen_fence_chicken_2.name: Sturdy Painted Hen Fence
pen_fence_chicken_2.desc: Strong posts and a coat of paint: the hens feel safe and lay a few more eggs.

pen_fence_cow_1.name: Mend the Cow Fence
pen_fence_cow_1.desc: The rails are loose and the cows push through. Mend them and the cows give all their milk.

pen_fence_cow_2.name: Sturdy Painted Cow Fence
pen_fence_cow_2.desc: Strong planks and a coat of paint: calm cows give a little more milk.

pen_fence_sheep_1.name: Mend the Sheep Fence
pen_fence_sheep_1.desc: Wool snags on the old wire. Mend it and the sheep keep all their wool.

pen_fence_sheep_2.name: Sturdy Painted Sheep Fence
pen_fence_sheep_2.desc: Smooth planks that nothing snags on, and a coat of paint: a little more wool.
